exact_quantifiers.claim_3: For p in [1,infinity), any norm on R^k, continuous rho and sigma give continuity; for every compact K subset ell_p(R^k), continuous non-polynomial activation implies F_DS is dense in C(K/G_infinity).
exact_quantifiers.claim_4: For p in [1,infinity), rho with componentwise p-growth and continuous sigma gives W_p continuity; for every compact Q subset P_p(R^k), Lipschitz continuous non-polynomial activation asymptotically polynomial at both infinities implies F_NDS dense in C(Q).
exact_quantifiers.claim_5: Every function in F_W is delta_cut continuous, and span over every m>=2 and all symmetric real a,b is dense in C(W_0,delta_cut).
